backward_compat_traps.rule: DPV1/DPV2 are backward-compatible extensions of DPV0; a device may support only DPV0.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Assuming every PROFIBUS-DP slave supports DPV1/DPV2 acyclic/isochronous services is wrong.

backward_compat_traps.rule: The PROFIBUS FCS is an 8-bit arithmetic checksum (modulo-256 sum), not a polynomial CRC.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating the FCS as a CRC is wrong.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Multiple masters share the bus by token passing; the token holder then polls slaves.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Modeling PROFIBUS as pure master-slave ignores the multi-master token ring.

backward_compat_traps.rule: PROFIBUS-DP has DP/PA profiles, a token+master-slave MAC, SD1-SD4 telegrams, DPV0/1/2 service levels, GSD, and DSAP/SSAP. Modbus has Function Codes + coils/registers over simple master-slave; PROFINET is Ethernet-based (IO-Controller/GSDML); EtherCAT uses an Ethernet datagram (0x88A4) + Distributed Clocks + FMMU.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Applying Modbus, PROFINET, or EtherCAT semantics to PROFIBUS is wrong.

fields.spec_version: PROFIBUS — IEC 61158 (Type 3) / IEC 61784-1 (CPF 3); DP service levels DPV0 / DPV1 / DPV2
previous_versions: IEC 61158 / IEC 61784 — international fieldbus standardization (PROFIBUS = Type 3 / CPF 3).

key_changes.summary: Base level: cyclic master-slave I/O data exchange (Set_Prm / Chk_Cfg / Data_Exchange), standard diagnostics, Global_Control SYNC/FREEZE.
Adds acyclic Read/Write by Slot/Index (MSAC_C1 / MSAC_C2) and acknowledged alarm handling; extended diagnostics.
Adds isochronous (clock-synchronous, equidistant) operation, slave-to-slave Data Exchange Broadcast (DXB), time stamping and redundancy.

future_versions_industry_outline.summary: Ethernet-based industrial communication from PI; PROFIBUS-DP devices map into PROFINET via proxies. PROFINET is a SEPARATE protocol (a parallel agent owns it) and is NOT this PROFIBUS class.

fields.version_naming_history_note: PROFIBUS (Process Field Bus) originated as the German DIN 19245 standard, became the European EN 50170 standard, and is internationally standardized as the IEC 61158 Type 3 fieldbus and IEC 61784-1 Communication Profile Family 3 (CPF 3). It is maintained by PROFIBUS & PROFINET International (PI). The DP profile is layered into the backward-compatible service levels DPV0 (cyclic), DPV1 (acyclic + alarms) and DPV2 (isochronous + slave-to-slave).
